controls.center_crop: same centered crop policy in every view
controls.shared_asymmetric_crop: one normalized off-center crop window reused in every view
controls.asymmetric_crop: independently sampled off-center crop window per view

interpretation_gate: Compare severity within a family and shared versus independent off-center windows at matched retained fraction. Do not call a second family a frozen-threshold failure unless its paired rotation delta exceeds 2 degrees or its depth AbsRel delta exceeds 0.05 on both registered datasets.
